title: MarkUs Extension
description: Settings for the Submit to MarkUs extension.

trustedOrigins.title: Trusted MarkUs origins
trustedOrigins.description: Origins (scheme + host + optional port, e.g. "https://markus.example.com") that notebooks are allowed to submit to. The Jupyter API token is sent as part of every submission, so only add MarkUs deployments you trust. A notebook's "markus" metadata supplies the submission URL, but that URL's origin must match one of these entries or the submission is rejected.
